recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a female subject with blonde hair and pink highlights, posed against a textured gray wall, integrated with hand-drawn punk-inspired graphics and high-contrast serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's pink hair streak matches the graphic heart and banner accents
Polka dot pattern on the shirt creates a rhythmic contrast with the solid wall texture
Graphic logo elements overlap the subject's space to create depth
Heavy dark eye makeup anchors the subject's gaze against the bright background
coreInvariants: Vibrant magenta/hot pink as the primary accent color
Layered jewelry including silver chains and skull motifs

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the right third of the frame, medium scale, looking directly at the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the graphic heart logo in the upper left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face to the pink hair streak, then up to the graphic logo and text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space on the left side, occupied by the textured wall and graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and cool gray (background and shirt base)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value overall with isolated pockets of high saturation in the pink elements.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to white, gray, black, and hot pink

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classic high-contrast serif for the main name; lowercase slab-serif for the subtitle.
letterConstructionRules: Main name uses all-caps with wide tracking
Subtitle is housed within a distressed, hand-drawn rectangular banner
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bar of the 'A' is slightly lowered
Letters are placed with slight baseline irregularity for a DIY feel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Traditional serif for authority paired with a modern slab-serif for a contemporary edge.
graphicDevices: Hand-drawn skull and crossbones with bone-shaped ends

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high-contrast serif look for the main name.
Sturdy slab-serif suitable for the subtitle banner.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a blonde woman with pink hair streaks wearing a black and white polka dot shirt and heavy silver jewelry, standing against a light gray textured concrete wall. Leave the upper left quadrant empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a hand-drawn skull and crossbones heart graphic in the upper left. Overlay the primary name in a black Bodoni-style font. Below it, add a distressed pink banner with the subtitle in white slab-serif lowercase text.

verificationChecks: Is the pink hair streak present?
Is the background texture visible and desaturated?
Does the graphic heart have a hand-drawn, 'doodle' quality?
Is the main text in a high-contrast serif?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the pink accent color
Density of the polka dot pattern
Amount of jewelry on the subject
mustRedesign: Avoid exact replication of the specific skull/heart logo
Do not use the specific artist's name
Ensure the polka dot shirt is a generic pattern

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between name and subtitle
Cohesive color matching between hair and graphics

postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence of the pink banner element
Ensure the subject's gaze is direct and neutral/serious
Confirm the background is a textured, neutral surface
Check that the graphic elements look hand-drawn
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject (Alt-Girl Style) + Textured Neutral Background + Hand-Drawn Punk Graphics + High-Contrast Serif Typography + Hot Pink Accents
